objective.text: Publish package assets under an explicit tag without assuming provider registration automatically copies files.

difficulty.rationale: Separate registering publishable paths from actually copying them into the application.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A package provider registers an asset mapping with publishes(..., "calendar-assets"). After provider registration, public/vendor/calendar is absent. What step normally performs that copy?

options.text: Resolve the provider from the container a second time.
options.rationale: Resolving the provider does not turn mapping registration into asset copying.
options.misconception: Resolving the provider does not turn mapping registration into asset copying.

options.rationale: Compiling Blade views does not copy tagged package asset paths.
options.misconception: Compiling Blade views does not copy tagged package asset paths.

options.rationale: publishes registers the mapping; vendor:publish performs the selected copy operation.

options.text: Add the tag name to the route middleware group.
options.rationale: Publish tags select filesystem mappings; they are not middleware aliases.
options.misconception: Publish tags select filesystem mappings; they are not middleware aliases.

explanation.summary: publishes registers the mapping; vendor:publish performs the selected copy operation.
